data.name: wavespeed-ai/wan-2.1/i2v-480p-lora
data.description: Generate unlimited 480P AI videos with WAN 2.1 Image-to-Video and custom LoRA support for personalized styles. Ready-to-use REST inference API, best performance, no coldstarts, affordable pricing.

duration.description: The duration of the generated media in seconds.

flow_shift.description: The shift value for the timestep schedule for flow matching.

guidance_scale.description: The guidance scale to use for the generation.

image.description: The image for generating the output.

path.description: URL or the path to the LoRA weights.

scale.description: The scale of the LoRA weights. This is used to scale the LoRA weight before merging it with the base model.

negative_prompt.description: The negative prompt for the generation.

num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

prompt.description: The positive prompt for the generation.

seed.description: The random seed to use for the generation. -1 means a random seed will be used.

size.description: The size of the generated media in pixels (width*height).
